description:
src/lib.rs:24-29 declares `pub mod types;` and `pub mod utils;` but the flat re-export block at lines 31-48 (added in commit d8fca5d 'expose method input/response structs at crate root') doesn't pull anything from them. PLAN.md:124-126 says types::ContactPresenceFilter exists; utils::format_receipt_timestamp also exists per PLAN.md. README does not mention either module.

Either:
(a) Intentional module-qualified-only surface (callers write jmap_chat_client::types::ContactPresenceFilter). Then document that intent — currently silent.
(b) Oversight in the d8fca5d sweep. If so, add the missing re-exports for consistency with the otherwise-flat surface.

The choice is a public-API decision. Probably (b) since the d8fca5d commit's intent was 'expose at crate root', but verify before publishing.
title: lib.rs declares pub mod types/utils but re-exports nothing from them
